svg.title: BlaBla concept
svg.desc: Owner intent is written into a BlaBla project as two different things. Authored project memory holds Mission, System, Process and Knowledge, which coding agents query through blabla status and explain but which never decide completion. Executable contracts hold Structure and Behavior, which blabla finish verifies to decide OVERALL GREEN. A bounded task holds transient scope, deliverables and findings for one change, and blabla challenge checks the recorded account of the work against that evidence without deciding completion. Agents write ordinary implementation code; BlaBla does not launch them.
